description: Battle prayer 0x547fe0 for party character idx. D4 formula callees 0x4fb4c0, 0x52b2f0, 0x547cb0, 0x5246c0 and 0x50e700 are address-stubbed (52b2f0 and 547cb0 returns are case inputs costRet and tuRet; the others' returns are ignored); excluded engine flow 0x5905f0, 0x562a50, 0x58ac00 and 0x408860 is stubbed with recorded arguments. The distance helper 0x4c7cb0, 0x51a9a0 and the list/record helpers run natively. Message renderer absent (0x68edcc=0), screen mode 0x68ec78=0, sound flag 0x650e50=0. Message k is the single unit 0x100+k (formats 0x5e8 and 0x5f0 are %s). Stack locals 0x10007f7c and 0x10007f84 are inputs: the original reads them before writing on some paths. fatigueStatus and sa_* are F-only inputs parked where the original does not read them. No executable data is embedded.
